hebrewText: וַ/נִּקַּח֙ אֶת אַרְצָ֔/ם וַ/נִּתְּנָ֣/הּ לְ/נַחֲלָ֔ה לָ/רֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְ/לַ/גָּדִ֑י וְ/לַ/חֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֥בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשִּֽׁי

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.

tokens.bdb: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
tokens.kjv: add, apply, appoint, ascribe, assign, [idiom] avenge, [idiom] be (healed), bestow, bring (forth, hither), cast, cause, charge, come, commit, consider, count, [phrase] cry, deliver (up), direct, distribute, do, [idiom] doubtless, [idiom] without fail, fasten, frame, [idiom] get, give (forth, over, up), grant, hang (up), [idiom] have, [idiom] indeed, lay (unto charge, up), (give) leave, lend, let (out), [phrase] lie, lift up, make, [phrase] O that, occupy, offer, ordain, pay, perform, place, pour, print, [idiom] pull, put (forth), recompense, render, requite, restore, send (out), set (forth), shew, shoot forth (up), [phrase] sing, [phrase] slander, strike, (sub-) mit, suffer, [idiom] surely, [idiom] take, thrust, trade, turn, utter, [phrase] weep, [phrase] willingly, [phrase] withdraw, [phrase] would (to) God, yield.

tokens.bdb: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
tokens.kjv: heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158 (נַחַל).

tokens.bdb: a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben
tokens.explanation: a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben
tokens.explanationEn: a Reubenite or descendant of Reuben

tokens.bdb: a Gadite (collectively) or descendants of Gad
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Gadite  or descendants of Gad
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Gadite  or descendants of Gad
tokens.explanation: a Gadite  or descendants of Gad
tokens.explanationEn: a Gadite  or descendants of Gad

tokens.kjv: half, middle, mid(-night), midst, part, two parts.

tokens.bdb: a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan
tokens.kjv: [idiom] correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

tokens.bdb: a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh
tokens.explanation: a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh
tokens.explanationEn: a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh
